handbook.what: The teacher's own insight tool: pick one of your classes and see its pace set against the average, over the period and for the measure you choose. It answers whether a class is moving well, which a roster of totals cannot.
how: Pick the class you want from **Your classes** if you teach more than one.
Pick the **measure** — the line underneath says exactly what it counts.
Pick the **window** the rate is computed over, and what to **compare to**.
Read the comparison block for your class's rate beside that average.
handbook.note: A class with too few sessions to compare honestly says so rather than showing a number built from nothing.
